messages:
Lina (CSM): Heads-up: VegaHealth EBR next Thurs 9am PT. Need final slide deck + one-pager that captures renewal runway and top 3 risks. Can we lock owners today?
Diego (Lead CSM): I can take the renewal runway one-pager. Will highlight usage trend + commitments.
Noah (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare the integration stability slide — will include recent error rates and a short remediation playbook.
Riya (Enablement): I'll own the enablement impact slide (training adoption, AE enablement notes) and coordinate a dry run. When's the rehearsal?
Lina (CSM): Rehearsal Tues 11am PT suggested. Riya can you send invite?
Riya (Enablement): Yep, sending invite now. Will include AE + demo owner.
Amir (AE): FYI I want a clear call-to-action on the renewal slide: committed seats vs trial expansion pipeline. Diego, can we sync for 15?
Diego (Lead CSM): Yup 15 min after this thread.
Tess (RevOps): Quick ask: include the ARR change (%) last 90d and any invoice disputes flagged. I'll add a small chart if you drop numbers in the sheet.
Noah (Solutions Eng): Uploading the raw error-rate export and a short runbook to the shared drive: #drive/shared/ebr/vegahealth/errors_and_playbook.xlsx
Lina (CSM): Also want to capture a customer success story — a one-line NPS quote or a short bullet on time-saved. Amir, can you pull a quote?
Amir (AE): I'll DM the customer and paste here if they reply before EOD.
Diego (Lead CSM): For the renewal risk matrix, I'm thinking: Engagement (weekly active users) vs Business Impact (high/med/low). I'll color-code and flag any red cells for escalation to Sales Ops.
Tess (RevOps): If you flag red, loop me + Lina. I'll prepare an escalation packet with contract dates + commercial levers.
Riya (Enablement): Demo owner? @Noah? We need someone to run the live flow.
Noah (Solutions Eng): I can be demo owner; will need a stable sandbox and a short dataset (5 customers) to surface the common failure modes.
Lina (CSM): Action list: Diego -> renewal runway one-pager (EOD), Noah -> integration stability slide + demo prep (tomorrow noon), Riya -> rehearsal invite + enablement slide (tomorrow 11am), Tess -> ARR chart + escalation sheet (EOD), Amir -> customer quote (EOD). I'll consolidate and draft exec asks after I get all pieces.
notifier-bot: Reminder set: VegaHealth EBR Thursday 09:00 PT (channel reminder).
Amir (AE): Quick flag: customer logged two invoice disputes in January — will confirm status with billing. Adding to escalation if unresolved.
Tess (RevOps): Got it. If disputes unresolved, we should push remediation steps in the one-pager (credit timeline / waiver options).
Noah (Solutions Eng): For the slide notes, adding this snippet for the stability section to explain retries + circuit breaker behavior:
"Retries: client-side 3 attempts; Circuit breaker: trips after 5 consecutive 5xx in 2 minutes; fallback: cached responses for read-only calls."
Diego (Lead CSM): Dropped a draft heatmap in the drive: #drive/shared/ebr/vegahealth/renewal_heatmap_v1.pptx — please comment.
Lina (CSM): Perfect. If anyone sees a sudden usage drop or exec no-show, call it out here and we'll consider a pre-EBR escalation.
Riya (Enablement): Rehearsal invite sent for Tue 11am PT. Adding meeting notes template to the deck folder.
Lina (CSM): Thanks all — will do a final pass Tue night and share the exec one-pager for signoff. End thread unless blockers arise.
